instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Of course, you cannot use just anything you like: only works and characters approved by their original creators are allowed. The help page also says the service has permission to use the original works it features. It has this permission through official agreements with their creators. This is the base that lets you enjoy asking “what if?”. The service first offered two works and four characters in Japan. Here, taking part in a story means moving the story forward through conversations. It also means making a story as a fan. Reading a work is fun. Now, it is also fun to think up what happens next. Until now, you could only say “if it were me, I’d do it this way” to yourself. With Vias, those words can help you start making a story. What will you say to a character you love? What will happen next in the story? So, where will your next part begin?
